map.动态心电图(Holter)室早室速分级器 使用指南: Ambulatory ECG (Holter) PVC/VT Grading Tool User Guide
map.输入24小时动态心电图中室早频率、形态、成对、室速及R-on-T现象，按Lown: Enter the PVC frequency, morphology, couplets, VT and R-on-T phenomenon from 24 h ambulatory ECG to grade the risk of ventricular arrhythmia by the Lown system, assisting clinical risk assessment and intervention decisions (for reference only).
map.Lown 分级参考：室早按频发、多形、连发、成串（室速）分级，越高心律失常风险越: Lown grading reference: PVCs are graded by frequency, polymorphism, runs and salvos (ventricular tachycardia); the higher the grade, the greater the arrhythmia risk, though modern practice emphasizes total burden and underlying heart disease more.
map.室早负荷量化：24h 室早占心搏百分比，>10%–15% 长期可致心动过速性心肌: Quantifying PVC burden: percentage of PVCs among all beats in 24 h; >10%-15% over the long term can cause tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy, so consider ablation or medication.
map.非持续性室速识别：连续 ≥3 个室早、持续 <30s，合并结构性心脏病或射血分数: Identifying non-sustained VT: >=3 consecutive PVCs lasting <30 s; those with structural heart disease or low ejection fraction have a poor prognosis and need further ICD assessment.
map.默认数据演练（24h 动态心电图分级）: Default data walkthrough (24 h ambulatory ECG grading)
map.：输入：24h 总心搏 98,000、室早 12,000（占 12.2%）、多形: : Input: 98,000 total beats in 24 h, 12,000 PVCs (12.2%), polymorphic, 80 couplets, 3 runs of non-sustained VT (longest 4 beats). Tool output: PVC burden 12.2% (>10% is high), Lown approximately IVb, with a note that structural heart disease should be assessed for cardiomyopathy risk and cardiology follow-up plus echocardiography recommended. Note: the grading is for reference only and should be combined with symptoms and EF.

map.心肌桥(壁冠状动脉)程度评估器: Myocardial bridging (intramural coronary artery) severity assessor
map.心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器: Heart failure NYHA classification and six-minute walk assessor
map.不一定。无结构性心脏病、EF 正常者即便室早多也多良性；但若负荷 >10%–15: Not necessarily. With no structural heart disease and normal EF, frequent PVCs are usually benign even in large numbers; but if the burden is >10%-15% or dizziness/blurred vision occurs, tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy may develop or underlying disease may be present, so echocardiography and etiological assessment are needed.
map.Lown 分级现在还用吗？: Is the Lown grading still used today?
map.Lown 分级偏急性心梗背景，现代更强调总负荷、形态（单/多形）、是否成对/连发: The Lown grading comes from an acute myocardial infarction background, whereas modern practice puts more weight on total burden, morphology (monomorphic/polymorphic), whether beats are paired or in runs, and underlying heart disease and EF. The value of ambulatory ECG lies in quantifying burden and capturing arrhythmias that match symptoms, not in reading the grading letter alone.
map.症状明显、负荷高致心肌病风险、或合并结构性心脏病/低 EF 的非持续室速，考虑药: With marked symptoms, high burden carrying cardiomyopathy risk, or non-sustained VT with structural heart disease or low EF, consider medication or catheter ablation; asymptomatic patients with normal cardiac function are usually observed. The decision rests with cardiology based on overall risk.
